campaign_goal: A/B test ad creatives for Veltrix Genesis. Context: Introducing Veltrix — a modern digital brand built for ambitious startups and next-generation businesses. This campaign focuses on building brand awareness, showcasing innovation-driven design and technology, and positioning Veltrix as a bold creative partner for businesses that want to stand out in the digital world.
